test_basicblock_equal_channels: test the BasicBlock residual block with equal input and output channel dimensions
test_basicblock_downsample: test the BasicBlock residual block with stride 2 to verify spatial downsampling output shape
test_basicblock_upsample: test the BasicBlock residual block with negative stride to verify spatial upsampling output shape
test_basicblock_quantize_partial: test the BasicBlock with partial quantization using fp32_skip and fp32_skip_relu quantization methods
test_bottleneck_downsample: test the Bottleneck residual block with stride 2 to verify spatial downsampling output shape
